minutes.headline: Finance Committee unanimously recommended approval of articles one, two and three for the special town meeting.
minutes.summary: A short pre-town-meeting session reviewed three money articles: a supplemental appropriation to reserves and the town clerk salary, a small prior-year wage expense, and the first-year cost of the clerical union contract. The committee welcomed a sixth member and re-voted the three articles by roll call, and agreed to let earlier votes on other articles stand.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted unanimously by roll call to recommend approval of article one, a supplemental appropriation to the reserve fund, salary reserve and town clerk salary.
The committee voted unanimously to recommend article two, a prior-year wage expense, which is slated for the consent calendar.
The committee voted unanimously to recommend article three, a transfer from the salary reserve to fund the first year of the clerical union contract.
The committee agreed to let its earlier votes on other articles stand rather than revote them.
The town manager is to send a revised motion sheet carrying tonight's votes before the special town meeting.

why_it_matters: The three articles move money among reserves, the salary reserve and the town clerk's pay, and fund the first year of a three-year clerical contract, so they set part of what the town spends on wages.
Residents at the special town meeting will be asked to vote on these same articles, and the committee's recommendation is the one they will hear.
